summary: PvP 3D game. Play clash bowling & amaze a crew with unlimited pro strikes.
description:
Bowling Clash is a sports game like tennis games or golf games, and even better! Not only do you have to knock the pins down, but bowl in style and amaze your crew! You become the most popular in the club, and greater sponsors sign contracts with you. You play on 3D bowling alleys, and explore new gear and other goodies to be ahead of your opponents - all to turn your bowling crew into followers and become the legend of bowling! In Bowling Clash you’ll get all the fun, excitement, and thrill of a real bowling game — on mobile in real-time. If you like to play tennis, pool, darts, billiards, curling, pinball, golf, or mini-golf, this clash game is for you. It’s a two person arcade fun sports simulation. And it’s a cool way to spend your idle time. It’s free, easy enough for kids, and challenging enough for casual players. Wait no more! Kick the ball, bowl with friends, clash, and strike on the amazing 3D lanes! It’s a ball blast! It’s gonna be your favorite pinball game!

KEY CLASH FEATURES:  
ONLINE PVP GAMES
 Get all the excitement of playing with opponents worldwide in real-time.

BUILD UP YOUR CHARACTER 
Customize your character by skilling up the bowling stats and upgrading the balls and gear.

BALLS, GEAR, AND FANTASTIC LOCATIONS 
Bowl competitive 1v1 games with tons of cool balls on every fantastic 3D bowling alley in the game: Backstreet Lane, Arctic Tundra, Gold Rush, Zen, Antique Library, Hall of Fame, and more.

QUICK PVE GAMES  
If you don’t want multiplayer, play PvE games! No opponents, no waiting, your success depends entirely on you! 

LIKES AND FOLLOWERS 
Amaze your bowling crew with cool strikes to gain more followers and become more popular among the crew in the bowling galaxy.

FAME! THE REASON YOU’RE HERE  
Upgrade your Fame level to sign contracts with greater sponsors, get better rewards, collect every single ball, and become the legend of a worldwide bowling crew!

And enjoy other cool features in the game:
Amazing graphics 
Easy-to-master controls
Season pass rewards  
Unlimited practice 
Golden nickname
Ad rewards 
Boosters
Quests 
 Leagues 
Newsfeed journal
Сhat
And many more!

Make sure you don't skip this bowling multiplayer game! Dive into the 3D sports galaxy, enjoy stunning graphics, and keep honing your skills and character endlessly. Plus, don't forget to join our bowling community club on Facebook and Instagram for some fun interactions with other players in your idle time. And if you're up for a laugh, check out our Giphy channel for tons of entertainment!

Bowlers, here's the last call! Come and bowl the balls! Strike them down for good, ball after ball.  

Need help or wanna chat with our crew? Drop us a line at support@squaretriangle.team. 
More info here https://squaretriangle.team  
See you on the lanes!

And one last thing! It’s as much fun as your favorite pool, golf, pinball, softball, tennis, snooker, dodgeball, funball, and other clash sports simulators. If you want to play free with opponents, then PvP multiplayer matches are at your service. If you are tired of the competition and pressure of PvP games, you can play blitz ball games against the pins in the PvE mode, which provides 13 levels of Sponsor activities with different difficulty levels. If you are looking for some variety, take part in weekly leaderboards in Leagues, keep an eye on the Seasons to collect as many rewards as possible, complete Quests and Premium Quests, show off in the Journal, collect bowling ballz and other Inventory items - and most importantly - upgrade the balls to win and crash your opponents with powerful balls and strikes in 1v1 bowling games! There's nothing like winning and being the king of the bowling galaxy.
